input:
CURRENT SCENE:
子思认为，对孩子来说，读书最重要，特别是学哲学。孟子不是练习写文章，就是看哲学书。孟子从五岁一直学哲学。他才五岁就学哲学，难怪他成为很有名的哲学家。

ITEMS:

[I10] 就是【看】哲学书   correction: 看 → 看到   strength: error
  checker's note: her pattern: 看 -> 看到 (corrected 37/71 in train)
  rule card (perception_look_see, Vocabulary): 看 is “look”; 看到 is “see/catch sight of” and shows that the person actually sees something. Use 看到 when the narrative gives the result of seeing.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: the person actually sees/catches sight of <thing or situation>, so use 看到, not 看.  Her terms: 看look vs.看到see, no了, 看look, 看到see
  her past correction: 他成为[+了]哲学家
  her past correction: [+就]开始学哲学 — her note: 才 Num.就V.
  her past correction: 而是成为[哲学人→哲学家]

[I11] 孟子从五岁【^】一直学哲学   correction: ∅ → 起   strength: error
  checker's note: 从五岁 needs 起/开始 before 一直
  rule card (laoshi_negative_repetition, Vocabulary): 老是 means “always” and is used for something negative or to complain; for a neutral or positive repeated action, use 一直 or 常常 instead.  Pattern: <老是 + action> → <一直/常常 + action>: the action is neutral or positive, not something negative to complain about, so do not use 老是.  Her terms: 老是
  her past correction: 孟子从早到晚[老是→一直]学哲学 — her note: “老是“ for something negative, used to complain
  her past correction: 孟子决定[-他应该]学哲学
  her past correction: 孟子[一直学了→一直在学习]很多东西 — her note: 一直在+V., emphasizing always ongoing

[I12] 难怪【他】成为很有名的哲学家   correction: 他 → (delete)   strength: error
  checker's note: 他 repeats the subject of the clause before: zero form
  rule card (zero_redundant_pronoun, Coherence: reference): When the same person or thing is already clear in the same clause or close continuation, delete the repeated subject or possessive: use zero form. In 不是……而是……, put the subject before 不是 and do not repeat it after 而是.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <subject/possessive> is already clear, so delete it; Chinese uses zero form here.  Her terms: redundant, too many他, Subj.不是……而是……, Subj. before “不是……而是……”
  her past correction: 难怪他成为[名的→有名的]哲学家
  her past correction: 难怪他长大以后[当→成为]很有名的哲学家
  her past correction: [-他]难怪成为了一个很聪明的哲学家

items.explanation: 孟子 actually sees the philosophy books, so use 看到see, not 看look.
Use 从五岁起一直学哲学 to show that the action started at age five and continued.
孟子 is already clear from the previous clause, so delete the redundant 他; Chinese uses zero form here.
